how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BEL Deputy Engineer Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BEL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BEL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BEL Deputy Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the BEL Deputy Engineer post is 04 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering/AMIE in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Communication, or Telecommunication from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Deputy Engineer position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Deputy Engineer post in Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Deputy Engineer post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Deputy Engineer post is 28 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs.472, which includes Rs.400 plus 18% GST. SC/ST/ESM/PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the BEL Deputy Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test carrying 85 marks, followed by an Interview that carries 15 marks. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Deputy Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Deputy Engineer (E-II grade) post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs.40,000-3%-Rs.1,40,000, payable in USD, along with other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or fixed-tenure job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Deputy Engineer post is on a Fixed Tenure basis, as indicated in the official notification released by Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL).

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What are the allowances provided to the selected Deputy Engineers?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be eligible for allowances such as Performance Related Pay (PRP), Medical Facilities, Provident Fund, Gratuity, Foreign Allowance, and Hardship Allowance (if posted to Agalega).
